primary_facts: The October 9 SEC 8-K states that BTOC begins post-split Nasdaq trading on October 15, 2026.
No fractional shares are issued; fractions are rounded up to the next whole post-split share.
For beneficial holders through a brokerage firm, the company states its intent to round fractional shares at the participant level.
Cash is not paid for fractional shares.
decision_reason: This is unusually close to the v2 round-up mechanism, including participant-level brokerage language, but its SEC acceptance on October 9 occurred before the repaired v2 T0 of October 12 21:00Z. The protocol explicitly excludes all event/document exposure before the new T0. The fact that split-adjusted trading starts October 15 does not reset the event clock.
contamination_guard: Search results displayed third-party pre-split/current BTOC price snippets while locating the filing. Those prices are contaminated and must never be used to backfill this pre-T0 event or calibrate a future protocol. No protocol economic calculation was performed.
ordering_effect: Armlogi is permanently excluded from the fresh v2 round-up sample. It can remain documentary evidence that participant-level round-up language exists, but it cannot count as a prospective case or an implementation survivor.
next_action: Continue chronological post-T0 admission for a genuinely new operative reverse-split filing. Before price access require accepted time after T0, fixed ratio, explicit round-up treatment, effective/entitlement timing allowing a post-event purchase, and no disclosed aggregation/record-holder restriction that facially defeats Q=1.
